name: Rainbow Border Button
description: Dark pill with a rotating rainbow conic border and a blurred rainbow glow pooling underneath.
a11y: Native button; decorative motion stops under reduced motion.
perf: One registered @property angle animation; 0 KB JS.
prompt: Create a rainbow-border button: register `@property --k-rb-a` (<angle>), paint the background as `linear-gradient(fg,fg) padding-box, conic-gradient(from var(--k-rb-a), rose, amber, lime, cyan, violet, rose) border-box` with a 2px transparent border, plus a blurred ::after glow using the same conic gradient under the button; animate the angle to 360deg in 3s linear.

name: Ripple Button
description: Material ink ripple that grows from the exact press point and fades, sized to cover the whole button.
a11y: Native button; ripples aria-hidden; skipped under reduced motion.
perf: One short-lived span per press, CSS keyframe.
prompt: Build a ripple button: on pointerdown add a span at the press point sized to 2× the button diagonal, animate scale 0→1 and opacity .45→0 over 650ms (cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1)), remove it after. Button is overflow-hidden; ripple uses currentColor.

name: Arrow Slide Button
description: Hover sweeps a fill in from the left, nudges the label and swaps the arrow out to the right as a new one slides in.
a11y: Native button; same effect on focus-visible; transitions off under reduced motion.
prompt: Create an arrow-slide CTA: outlined pill with label + circular arrow badge. On hover/focus a full-width fill scales X 0→1 from the left (500ms cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1)), the label shifts 4px and inverts color, and inside the badge the arrow translates out to +32px while a duplicate enters from −32px.

name: Expanding Icon Button
description: Icon-only circles that widen to reveal a label on hover or focus — compact toolbars that still explain themselves.
a11y: aria-label always present, so the label isn't required to understand the control; expands on focus-visible.
prompt: Build an expanding icon button with the CSS grid trick: label wrapper is `display:grid; grid-template-columns: 0fr` transitioning to `1fr` on hover/focus-visible (300ms), inner overflow hidden, label fades in after 100ms.

name: Gooey Liquid Button
description: Blobs bubble out from the pill on hover and fuse with it through an SVG goo filter — a liquid, organic hover.
a11y: Label is outside the filtered layer so text stays crisp; blobs hidden under reduced motion.
perf: SVG filter on a small area; CSS transitions.
prompt: Create a gooey button: an absolutely positioned layer (pill + 5 circles) filtered by SVG `feGaussianBlur(6)` → `feColorMatrix` alpha `20 −9` → `feComposite atop`; on hover the circles translate out of the pill (±14–24px) with a back-out ease and staggered delays so they stretch like liquid. Keep the label above the filtered layer.

name: Send Button
description: Paper-plane send: the plane winds back, takes off along an arc and disappears, then a check draws in.
a11y: aria-live polite announces Sent; guards double sends.
prompt: Build a send button: on click the plane icon animates x [0,−4,60], y [0,3,−30], rotate [0,−10,25], opacity [1,1,0] over 700ms (anticipation then launch), then a check pops in with a bouncy spring and draws its path; the button turns green and the label rolls to 'Sent', resetting after 2.4s.

name: Download Progress Button
description: Download pill shrinks into a circular progress ring, fills, then pops a checkmark.
a11y: aria-label tracks the percentage; aria-live announces completion.
perf: Layout width morph + one stroke animation.
prompt: Create a download button that morphs (Motion layout) from a labeled pill into a 48px circle containing a progress ring (pathLength = progress/100 with a spring), then into a green check that pops in; resets after 1.8s. Progress can be controlled or simulated.

name: Pulse CTA
description: Primary action that emits two staggered sonar rings — 'go live', 'join call', unread attention.
a11y: Use for one primary action only; rings hidden under reduced motion.
prompt: Make a pulse button: ::before and ::after copy the background and scale to (1.6, 2) while fading out over 2.2s, the second delayed 1.1s; isolated stacking context so rings sit behind the button.

name: Neumorphic Toggle
description: Soft-UI toggle that sits raised when off and presses into the surface when on, with an eased shadow swap.
a11y: aria-pressed toggle with visible focus ring; don't rely on shadows alone for state (icon color changes too).
perf: box-shadow transition on a small element.
prompt: Create a neumorphic toggle on a #e6e9ef surface: off = raised (8px 8px 16px #c5c8ce, −8px −8px 16px #fff), on = inset versions of both shadows plus accent icon color and a slight icon scale; 300ms ease.

name: Emoji Burst Button
description: Every click sprays emoji particles from the cursor that arc up, spin and fall away — instant celebration.
a11y: Particles are aria-hidden and pointer-events none; skipped under reduced motion.
perf: 14 DOM nodes per click, removed after 1.3s; one rAF loop per burst.
prompt: Build an emoji-burst button: on click spawn N fixed-position emoji spans at the cursor with random upward angles (±63°) and speeds 260–580px/s, simulate gravity 900px/s², spin, shrink and fade over 1.3s in one rAF loop, then remove them.

name: Subscribe Morph
description: Newsletter input + button pill that morphs into a compact green 'You're on the list' confirmation.
a11y: Real form with labelled email field; confirmation uses role=status.
prompt: Create a newsletter pill (input + Subscribe button) as a Motion `layout` form; on valid submit show a busy state, then morph the pill width 360→230px into a green confirmation with a check that spins in; role=status.

name: Rating Stars
description: Star rating built as a real radio group: hovering previews, choosing pops the stars in sequence.
a11y: Native radio inputs (arrow keys work), labelled per star, visible focus ring.
perf: Per-star transform keyframes on change only.
prompt: Build a star rating on visually hidden radio inputs; hover previews fills; on change, stars up to the value animate scale [1,1.35,1] and rotate [0,−12,0] staggered 60ms (keyed to replay).

name: Morphing Icons
description: Icon strokes that morph between states — menu↔close, play↔pause, plus↔minus, arrow↔check — instead of crossfading.
a11y: Icon is aria-hidden; put the label/aria-pressed on the parent button.
perf: Motion interpolates SVG `d` with matching point counts.
prompt: Create morphing icons by animating SVG path `d` strings with identical command structure between states (Motion animates them): hamburger lines to an X, play triangle halves to two pause bars, plus to minus (vertical stroke rotates 90° and fades), arrow to check. Snappy spring.
